title: Nazirite Vow
summary: The Nazirite vow involved special consecration to the Lord, including separation from wine, avoiding corpse defilement, and not cutting the hair during the vow.
background: Nazirite passages show visible dedication and separation for a season or, in some cases, a life calling. They should not be confused with ordinary holiness commands for all Israelites.
teachingHelp: Use Nazirite passages to discuss consecration, calling, and the danger of treating outward signs as substitutes for obedience.
